notes: Direct API pricing (per 1M tokens, standard tier). Reasoning tokens are billed at the model's output rate by every major provider.

Effort multipliers represent typical hidden-reasoning-token counts as a multiple of visible output tokens. Actual usage varies wildly by prompt complexity - these are calibrated estimates from published benchmark traces and community telemetry, not vendor numbers.
Cached input rates are the vendor's published cache-read price. DeepSeek prices are the peak-hour rate; off-peak is half.

Verified 2026-09-11 against platform.claude.com, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and api-docs.deepseek.com. Manually maintained; provider direct-pricing pages have no public API.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.notes: OpenAI's flagship. Effort runs none through max; xhigh and max can spend well past 8x the visible output in hidden reasoning. Above 272K input tokens the price doubles.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.notes: GPT-5.5-class quality at half the price. The default production pick for agent loops.

models.label: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.notes: Cut 80% on 2026-07-30. Cheap enough that reasoning tokens rarely dominate the bill.

models.label: GPT-5.5
models.notes: Superseded by GPT-5.6 Sol but still on the API. Same shape of hidden-reasoning behaviour.

models.label: Claude Fable 5.1
models.notes: Thinking is always on and cannot be disabled; the effort level sets how deep it goes. Cache read dropped to $0.25 at launch, so a cached system prompt is close to free.

models.label: Claude Opus 5
models.notes: Adaptive thinking runs by default. Half of Fable's price for most of its coding and agent performance.

models.label: Claude Sonnet 5
models.notes: Workhorse reasoning model. $2 / $10 became the permanent list price on 2026-08-10.

models.label: Claude Haiku 4.5
models.notes: Uses a manual thinking budget (budget_tokens) rather than adaptive thinking, so the multiplier is really a cap you set. Good for high-volume classification and routing.

models.label: Gemini 3.1 Pro
models.notes: Price shown is the <=200K-token tier; $4 / $18 above it. Strong long-context handling.

models.label: Gemini 3.7 Flash
models.notes: Introductory price through 2026-12-31 ($1.50 / $7.50 after). Thinking levels low, medium, high.

models.label: DeepSeek V4 Pro
models.notes: Open weights (MIT). Reasons verbosely: max mode routinely spends 20x the visible output. Peak-hour price; off-peak halves it.
